_about: SCHEMA EXAMPLE ONLY - the clips, URLs and claims below belong to a different brand (fitlitter) and exist to show the EDL shape; never reuse them for another brand. Worked example: a 20s VO-led Problem -> Solution ad for Fit Litter crystals, 9:16, from fitlitter library clips (search_clips_visually, 2026-09-29). Every clip was sprite-checked and probed; the render was verified (1080x1920, 20.00s) and QC-checked with contact_sheet.mjs. On-screen claims are quoted from fitlitter.com.au (99% dust-free; 4x better odour control - site source: 28-day ammonia test vs paper).

_schema.output: path for the rendered MP4, relative to this file. Default out/ad.mp4
_schema.aspect: "9:16" (1080x1920) or "16:9" (1920x1080). Ask the user. Caption size and side margins adapt automatically.
_schema.width/height: only to force an off-spec size; set both.
_schema.fps: default 30. Every segment is normalized to this (library clips range 24-60fps).
_schema.targetDuration: 15, 20, 25 or custom. Builder warns if the render misses by >0.5s.
_schema.fit: cover | contain | blurfill - default cover. Most fitlitter UGC displays portrait (many are stored landscape with a -90 rotation flag - the builder reads it): cover in 9:16, blurfill in 16:9. Landscape clips (podcast, some pro shoots): cover in 16:9; in 9:16 cover + anchorX (one subject) or blurfill.
_schema.workDir: scratch dir, wiped each run. Default .adwork. On Windows use a SHORT path like C:/adwork (260-char cwd limit).

segments[].url | file: clip downloadUrl, rawVideoDownloadUrl, or a local path (a Remotion render, a user upload)
segments[].in / out: seconds into the source. Always set them - library clips run 10-130s.
segments[].anchorX / anchorY: where a cover-crop sits: 0 = left/top, 0.5 = centre (default), 1 = right/bottom. Only matters when the source orientation differs from the output (landscape crew/aerial clips in a 9:16 ad). clips.json has suggestedAnchorX916 for those.
segments[].move: pushin | pullback | glideleft | glideright | glideup | glidedown - motion without a cut.
segments[].transition: how this segment ENTERS: "cut" (default) or {type, duration}. Types: fade, dissolve, fadeblack, fadewhite, swipe*, smooth*, wipe*, reveal*, cover*, circleopen, circleclose, radial, zoomin, squeezeh, squeezev, pixelize, hblur. Directions: left/right/up/down.
segments[].audioLead: J-cut: seconds this segment's AUDIO starts before its picture. Needs keepClipAudio true (creator A-roll / mixed ads).
segments[].audioTail: L-cut: seconds this segment's audio continues after its picture ends. Needs keepClipAudio true.
segments[].anchorX: where a cover-crop sits: 0 = left/top, 0.5 = centre (default), 1 = right/bottom. Matters when source orientation differs from the output. Check the subject (cat, tray, hand) stays in the crop across in/out.

audio.music: { file, duck (true), duckDb (-9), fadeOut (1.0), offsetDb (-4) }. LEAVE gainDb OUT: the builder measures speech and bed with EBU R128 and places the bed offsetDb (4dB) under the voice.
audio.keepClipAudio: default false. false for every VO-led cut (B-roll/No Actor, some carry off-camera narration). true for testimonial / mashup / mixed A-roll ads.

captions[].start / end: seconds on the OUTPUT timeline (the builder prints it - transitions shorten it)
captions[].text | lines: 4-5 words visible at once; lines[] + stagger for an ordered list
captions[].band: upper | middle | lower - pick per shot so it clears the cat, the tray, faces and any burned-in text
captions[].anim: fadeup (default) | fadedown | fade | slideleft | slideright | pop | punch | none. One punch per ad.

_schema.captionStyle: { font (PT Sans - bundled, the site font), fontSize, primary (#FFFFFF), outline (#1F2621), outlineWidth, bold (true) } - override with the user's guidelines if supplied

_script: Litter all over your floors? [FAK] Soggy paper, every single day. [FKS] With Fit Litter, you just scoop the poop. [GEG] Ninety-nine percent dust-free crystals with four times better odour control. [XWH] Less smell, less mess, less work - shop fitlitter dot com dot a-u. [XMT] - 43 words at ~2.6 w/s = ~16.5s under a 20s picture, leaving air for the hook and the end beat.
_notes: (1) VO-led: every clip is Actor B-roll or No Actor and keepClipAudio is false. (2) Problem half joins fast (0.25s swipe); solution half slow (0.5s smooth + a pushin). (3) The pivot FKS -> GEG is the one match cut: same scoop action and framing, so a hard cut. (4) FAK/FKS are competitor paper litter - fine for a crystal ad, never for an ECO (paper) ad. (5) Rejected on review: NCN end card (shows the ECO bag, burned-in Subscribe Now), WOO/WON/WOP end cards (20% off promo - only if the user confirms it is live).

segments._beat: HOOK - Matthew sweeping scattered litter off a carpet (Paper Litter Tracked On Floor, Actor B-roll). Wall-only frames after ~7s.
AGITATION - scoop lifting soggy grey paper pellets from a teal tray (No Actor).
PIVOT - the same scoop move into white Fit Litter crystals (No Actor). THE match cut: scoop -> scoop, so a hard cut.
segments._why: Match cut on the pivot - same framing and action continue across the cut.

segments._beat: PROOF - black cat stepping into a tray of crystals (Kelsey, No Actor). Stored 2160x3840 portrait.
segments._why: Solution half: slow, smooth, rightward = forward.

segments._beat: CTA - white Fit Litter bag beside a hooded tray (Charli, No Actor), slow drift.
segments._why: Down onto the call to action.

audio._music: No gainDb on purpose - the builder places the bed 4dB under the VO by measurement. vo.mp3 from ElevenLabs creative_generate_speech (or the user's upload); bed.mp3 from creative_generate_in_flow (node_type music) or the user's upload. The verified render was made with the audio block reduced to {keepClipAudio:false} (captions only).

_timeline.clipDurations: FAK 3.20 + FKS 3.00 + GEG 4.90 + XWH 6.00 + XMT 4.15 = 21.25s of source
_timeline._note: Each segment starts early by its own transition. Time captions against the builder's printed timeline.
